items: Touchpad now works on Mac and iPad: new Mac and iPad tabs in the Pairing guide, with Keyboard and mouse or Gamepad mode on Mac
Fixed endless reconnecting when the host drops the link right away. JoyLink now stops and shows how to pair again
Home lists only hosts like computers and TVs. Headphones and watches move to Other Bluetooth devices
The screen stays on while discoverable, and the list updates right after pairing
New Connection check: a live checklist from Bluetooth to a test input. Find it in Settings → Connection or tap Troubleshoot on the home screen
Back in the app, it re-registers and reconnects to your last device automatically
New setup guide on the gamepad screen with steps for PC, TV and more
Clearer connection errors with the cause and retry progress
Fixed "not supported" after a temporary Bluetooth error
Cleaner status bar and navigation bar on phones using 3-button navigation
